in_sanskrit.name: सनातन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सनातनम् सत्यम् परमं धर्म: 'Sanatana' means eternal, everlasting, timeless, and 'dharma' refers to righteousness, duty, or law. Together, Sanatan can be interpreted as 'the eternal dharma' or 'the unchanging law of the universe'.

in_hindi.name: सनातन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sanatan in Hindi is translated as 'sadyacharan', which means 'one who is always in conformity with the eternal law'. This name signifies a person who lives in accordance with the eternal dharma and follows the unchanging law of the universe.

in_tamil.name: சனாதன
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sanatan in Tamil is translated as 'kuzhandhaiyl vazhkum agkariyam', which means 'the one who has the eternal virtue'. This name signifies a person who embodies the eternal virtues and upholds the unchanging principles of righteousness.

in_telugu.name: శనాతదన
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sanatan in Telugu is translated as 'purnamainadeshu', which means 'the one who possesses the full manifestation of the deity'. This name signifies a person who embodies the divine qualities of the eternal law and lives in accordance with the unchanging dharma.

in_marathi.name: Sanatan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanatan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanatan is a Sanskrit name that means eternal, timeless, and enduring. It is a powerful name that signifies the eternal nature of the soul and the universe. It is often used to describe the eternal and unchanging nature of God, the Self, and the universe.
